assumptions: Exploratory current-based single-sign-per-neuron approximation, not measured receptor-specific polarity. Zero means unsupported fast transmission, not a missing anatomical edge. Modulatory transmission requires a separate validated model.
Contact counts are anatomical multiplicities, not fitted conductance or physiological weights.
Every internal pair is retained, including cross-column, recurrent, weak and self connections; no new contact threshold is applied.
Raw ground_truth neurotransmitter fields do not establish per-cell experimental measurement.
The patch omits photoreceptors and other visual populations and is not the whole MaleCNS connectome.
No resting release, membrane constant, gain, adaptation, receptor model or sensory response is inferred here.

definitions.defaultTreatment: No boundary transmission is simulated by this extraction; any later closure or external drive must be declared
definitions.distinctOutsideNeurons: Unique outside bodies within the stated group; do not sum across groups
definitions.incoming: All contacts from retained neurons outside this patch to selected neurons
definitions.outgoing: All contacts from selected neurons to retained neurons outside this patch
definitions.scope: Boundary counts reference the retained graph, not unassigned segments excluded by the compiler
definitions.sourceSign: Copied modeled fast sign of the actual presynaptic neuron; not measured receptor-specific polarity

provenance.attribution: FlyEM / HHMI Janelia, University of Cambridge, MRC Laboratory of Molecular Biology, and Google Research

reproduction.comparison: With the same inputs and runtime versions, serialized output bytes are deterministic. Use --check to compare without writing.

selection.geometryMeaning: Published optic-column labels, not calibrated visual angles or retinal positions

nomination.interpretation: Offline diagnostic nomination only; no model, candidate or gate changed
nomination.selection: 19 nearest exact common columns to coordinate-wise median; squared Euclidean LABEL distance, ties hex1 then hex2; not a hex angular metric
